questions.question: What does Ezekiel 7 repeatedly announce?
options: The exiles will soon return home
The end has come upon the land
A new king will restore the throne
A time of peace is near at hand
questions.answer: The end has come upon the land

questions.question: What would happen to their silver and gold in the day of wrath?
options: It could not deliver them; they would throw it in the streets
It would be hidden away deep within the temple vaults
It would buy their safety and ransom their very lives
It would multiply many, many times over in all of their storehouses
questions.answer: It could not deliver them; they would throw it in the streets

questions.question: Ezekiel 7 says the day of the LORD's wrath has come and disaster follows disaster.
An end! The _____ has come upon the four corners of the land.
They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will seem _____.
